name.description: Lowercase identifier; must match the file name.

official_sources.description: URL prefixes of the tool's own official documentation sites, in addition to repo. Every release source must sit under repo or one of these.

upstream_license.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream repository's license.

notes.description: Short factual note about how upstream publishes compatibility.

kubernetes_range.description: A range of Kubernetes minors. Omit min when upstream gives no lower bound; max is 'latest' when upstream leaves the range open.

version.description: Tool release line, as upstream names it.

version_range.description: Band of tool versions, only when upstream states its claim for a band (for example '>= 0.18') and not per version. Omit max when the band is open-ended, min when it has no lower bound.

tested.description: Kubernetes versions upstream states it tested, at the precision upstream gives: a patch version, or a minor when upstream names no patch.

stated.description: Range upstream states is supported or expected, without a testing claim.

min.description: Omit when upstream gives no lower bound.

max.description: A Kubernetes minor, or 'latest' when upstream leaves the range open.

wording.description: The short phrase upstream uses for this claim.

unsupported.description: Kubernetes minors, or ranges of minors, upstream explicitly states are not supported.

source_commit.description: Upstream commit that last changed the source file, as of the verified date; for release notes, the commit the release tag points to.

delisted.description: Date this row was removed from the upstream source, or was found removed when the removal date is not known.
